---
title: "Second-line treatment — endpoint preparation"
format: html
---

- Added analysis: time from random selection to the start of line 2; the SAP endpoint (switch or stop from first-line start) is not analysed
- Time starts at randomization; follow-up runs to the data lock, no 182-day cap
- Cause-specific second-line hazard: death before line 2 is censoring
- Composite: first of line 2 or death (time to next treatment or death)

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(here)
library(arrow)
library(yaml)
library(knitr)
library(tidyverse)

config <- read_yaml(here("config", "analysis.yml"))
source(here("R", "survival.R"))

results_dir <- here("analysis", "12-second-line", "results")
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

cohort <- read_parquet(here("analysis", "00-data", "results", "analysis-cohort.parquet"))
```

## Endpoint derivation

```{r}
#| label: derive-endpoint
#| include: false
endpoint <- derive_dated_event_endpoints(
  cohort,
  event_date_col = "second_line_start_date",
  event_indicator_col = "status_second_line",
  event_label = "second-line",
  data_lock = config$analysis$data_lock
) |>
  rename(
    second_line_origin_date = origin_date,
    second_line_follow_up_limit = follow_up_limit,
    second_line_extends_recorded_follow_up = extends_recorded_follow_up,
    second_line_after_follow_up_limit = after_follow_up_limit,
    second_line_event_or_censor_date = event_or_censor_date,
    event_second_line = event_first,
    event_death_before_second_line = event_death_before_first,
    event_second_line_or_death = event_composite,
    second_line_censor_reason = censor_reason,
    derived_time_to_second_line_days = time_days,
    second_line_exclusion_reason = exclusion_reason,
    second_line_in_analysis = in_analysis
  ) |>
  mutate(
    second_line_censor_reason = replace_values(
      second_line_censor_reason,
      "event_observed" ~ "second_line_observed",
      "death_before_event" ~ "death_before_second_line"
    ),
    second_line_exclusion_reason = replace_values(
      second_line_exclusion_reason,
      "event_before_randomization" ~ "second_line_before_randomization"
    )
  )

included <- filter(endpoint, second_line_in_analysis)

stopifnot(
  all(endpoint$second_line_exclusion_reason %in% c(
    "included", "second_line_before_randomization", "no_positive_follow_up"
  )),
  all(endpoint$event_second_line_or_death ==
        endpoint$event_second_line + endpoint$event_death_before_second_line),
  all(endpoint$second_line_event_or_censor_date <= endpoint$second_line_follow_up_limit),
  all(endpoint$data_lock == config$analysis$data_lock),
  # The derivation must reproduce the exported endpoint.
  all(included$derived_time_to_second_line_days == included$time_to_second_line_days),
  all(included$event_second_line == included$status_second_line),
  all(included$event_death_before_second_line ==
        (included$second_line_competing_status == 2L))
)
```

## Analysis dataset

```{r}
#| label: prepare-analysis-data
#| include: false
prepared <- included |>
  # The column order sets the MICE visit sequence; diagnosis is joined later.
  select(
    id, tx, time_to_second_line_days, event_second_line,
    event_death_before_second_line, event_second_line_or_death, ecog_fstcnt,
    stage_binary, lung, age, gender, albumin, bilirubin, c_reactive_protein,
    lactate_dehydrogenase
  )

stopifnot(
  nrow(prepared) > 0L,
  all(prepared$time_to_second_line_days > 0)
)

endpoint_audit <- endpoint |>
  count(tx, second_line_exclusion_reason, name = "participants")

event_counts <- prepared |>
  summarise(
    participants = n(),
    second_line_events = sum(event_second_line),
    death_before_second_line = sum(event_death_before_second_line),
    composite_events = sum(event_second_line_or_death),
    censored_without_either = sum(event_second_line_or_death == 0),
    .by = tx
  )

write_parquet(endpoint, file.path(results_dir, "endpoint.parquet"))
write_parquet(prepared, file.path(results_dir, "prepared.parquet"))
write_parquet(endpoint_audit, file.path(results_dir, "endpoint-audit.parquet"))
write_parquet(event_counts, file.path(results_dir, "event-counts.parquet"))
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-second-line-endpoint-audit
#| tbl-cap: "Second-line analysis population and exclusions"
#| echo: false
kable(endpoint_audit)
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-second-line-event-counts
#| tbl-cap: "Observed second-line starts and competing deaths by randomized group"
#| echo: false
kable(event_counts)
```
